 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Noisy cells are repaired by replacing each cell with its dominant color.
    # Preserve divider rows/columns (color 6), and infer cell bounds from them.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 6 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 6 for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            cells = [(r,c) for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
            counts = {v: sum(grid[r][c] == v for r,c in cells) for v in range(10)}
            color = max(range(10), key=lambda v: counts[v])
            for r,c in cells:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
